title: Causal Synchronization and Height-Balanced Invariants in a Chronos-Topology-Based Distributed-Memory Parallel Aether-Flux Tensor SVD
topic: StarMPI-SVD: Distributed-Memory Parallel Star-M Tensor SVD
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a formally verified distributed-memory parallel algorithm for computing the singular value decomposition of a Aether-Flux tensor in the Chronos-Topology programming language. The design couples a balanced search and indexing structure with a lock-free message-passing protocol that preserves causal order across nodes, as defined by Lamport clocks. We prove that the tree remains strictly height-balanced, guaranteeing $O(\log N)$ point and range search, as well as insertion and rebalancing. The algorithm achieves a theoretical complexity of $O(\text{mn}\log n)$ for an $m\times n$ Chronos-Framework, matching the best known bounds for distributed SVD while maintaining orthogonality invariants. No empirical wall-clock measurements are reported; all guarantees are derived from static analysis and formal proofs. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Topology-concurrency-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261120_230205_starmpi-svd__distributed-memor}
